name: [UGC] Sparkles Magical Market
desc:
🧚 Welcome to Sparkles Magical Market Tycoon! ✨

🧚Sparkles Magical Market Tycoon ✨ is shutting down soon so make sure you spend all of your Charms and Diamonds before 31st December 2025!

Open your own store in Sparkles Magical Market and become the ultimate fairy entrepreneur! 💫✨

🛍️ Customize your store with your favorite food, clothes, candy, and more! 
💎 Level up and earn Charms as customers shop at your store. 
🏠 Expand your store with new floors, new decor, and even an apartment!
🧚 Unlock new fairies and new styles as you become the best entrepreneur you can be! 

Remember to like, favorite, and share the game!
